comment: The definition states that the LHR is accessible to authorised health workers, systems and individuals. It does not explicitly include authorised representatives, caregivers or care workers, even though these actors may be essential to continuity of care. The phrase “meaningful control of the individual” should also recognise direct, supported and legally delegated exercise of that control.

public.text: The definition states that the LHR is accessible to authorised health workers, systems and individuals. It does not explicitly include authorised representatives, caregivers or care workers, even though these actors may be essential to continuity of care. The phrase “meaningful control of the individual” should also recognise direct, supported and legally delegated exercise of that control.
public.suggestedRevision: Revise lines 13–20 to include “authorised health and care workers, systems, individuals and their authorised representatives”. Add: “Meaningful control may be exercised directly, with decision support, or through a legally authorised representative, with the scope and provenance of that authority recorded and auditable.”
